design.description: Every token and every state, rendered in the theme you are looking at. This page is the release gate: if two things here are not instantly distinguishable, the pass is not done.

sections.colorHint: Measured against the surface each token is used on. AA means the pair meets WCAG 2.2 at its required floor: 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for non-text UI.
sections.rampsHint: Every step is anchored to a contrast target on white and its chroma clamped to 93% of what the gamut allows at that lightness.
sections.surfacesHint: Depth is a surface step plus a hairline, never a shadow. In dark the ladder reverses: higher surfaces are lighter.
sections.typeHint: Inter for the interface, Geist Mono for keys and figures — both self-hosted, no network call.
sections.statesHint: Tone, icon and shape come from one table. Hue is never the only signal — read this section in greyscale and nothing should become ambiguous.
sections.entitiesHint: Twelve frozen hues, picked from the immutable id. Identity, never status.
sections.railHint: The timeline is one column: a 24px node carrying the state glyph, a 1px rail, and a warm 2px edge where a client can read the entry. Terminal states fill their node; cancelled stays outlined, because the quiet tone is transparent and a filled quiet node would have no ring at all.

design.typeSample: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

controls.hoverNote: Hover and press are 80ms colour changes; press adds a 1px downward nudge.

design.visibilityHint: The safety-critical pair. They differ in fill, icon, shape, weight and border — five channels, so that no eye, no screen and no colour-vision type can confuse them.
design.visibilityRow: A client-visible row also carries a 2px leading bar.
design.chartsHint: Five series, each at least 3:1 against the canvas and at least 0.10 apart in perceptual distance under normal, protan, deutan and tritan vision.
